core_meaning.primary_meaning: Aafreen is a Persian-origin name meaning “Praise, bravo, well done”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Persian word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Aafreen corresponds to the Persian form آفرين (Persian آفرین (āfarīn)). Its core sense is praise, bravo, well done. Aafreen is Persian آفرین (āfarīn) 'praise, bravo, well done'. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave عفرى (a different form) and labelled the origin Arabic; the name is Persian. The source gloss 'Brave, Encouragement, Praise' is partly unsupported; the lexical sense is 'praise'.

persian.name: آفرین
persian.long_meaning: Aafreen (آفرین) نامی برگرفته از زبان فارسی است و معنای اصلی آن آفرین، تحسین است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: आफ़रीन

arabic.name: آفرين
